archetypes.name: self-review-tally
archetypes.rationale: Synthetic fallback rows feed multiple audit consumers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the fallback paths for self-review tally rows in fluff-analysis and audit scan code. Check that empty or absent JSONL inputs synthesize the expected accepted and rejected records, while malformed JSONL never falls back. Verify synthetic rows do not create fake canonical categories. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: recovery-contract
archetypes.rationale: The prose and anti-polling harness encode operator recovery behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the /implement and shared orchestrator recovery wording with the updated anti-polling harness. Check that /design sentinel carve-outs remain intact and that /implement guidance stays notification-driven without implying nonexistent terminal sentinels. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
